description: Start here when someone wants to sign up to Etapa (the cycling training app) or get their own Etapa guide from this chat. Returns the questions the Etapa app asks a new rider, in order, with every option: the agreements, signing in (Google, or an emailed code), name, four riding questions, their AI companion, and their guide. Ask them one at a time, then build the guide.
name: etapa_signup_questions
title: Etapa sign-up: the questions to ask
